Name: Colorful Fish Ponds
Author: rokugin
Description:
[u][size=5]Install[/size][/u]
[size=3]1. [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
2. Unzip the mod folder into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.
(optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0.[/size]

[size=5][u]About[/u][/size]
[size=3]Saw a lot of requests for fish pond colors and it looked like a good way to get more practice making mods, with a focus on content packs to allow others to add or change functionality of the mod.
[/size]
[size=5][u]Compatibility[/u][/size]
[size=3]Works in singleplayer. Mostly works in multiplayer, will be trying to make it work better.
Should work with SVE.

[/size][size=5][u]Console Commands[/u][/size][size=3]
Currently the only commands are:
[code]﻿help rokugin.fishpack
rokugin.fishpack reload
[/code]
help rokugin.fishpack will list the commands and what they do.
rokugin.fishpack reload will reload the content packs and refresh the pond colors. This way you can make changes to your content packs and reload them and see the results without restarting the day, sleeping, or closing the game. As with all things modding, you may still need to restart the game or day to get things to reset properly, modding is just like that sometimes.

[/size][size=5][u]Color Overrides[/u][/size][size=3]
I'll work on adding the instructions to this website eventually, Nexus is a real pain to work with though, so for now you can find the content pack creation guide [url=https://github.com/rokugin/ColorfulFishPonds/blob/main/docs/author-guide.md]here
[/url][/size]
